A QUESTION FROM YOUR COMPUTER↗

ABSOLUTELY NOT. ↵

01 / THE SITUATION

You leave eggs
everywhere.

On the train.
In a meeting.
At 11pm on your phone,
twice.

Screenshots. Voice notes. Links. A photo of a whiteboard. A photo of a door. Six near-identical shots of one layout because you couldn’t decide.

Forty-one screenshots from one night you don’t remember taking.

You drop them and move on. That’s fine. Dropping them is the natural part. Finding them again is the part nobody has solved.

41 eggs today.All accounted for. ✓
02 / THE SHORTCUT↗

It’s a contact.

Your Mac is not a device in a list that may or may not appear.

It’s a contact. It has a name. It sits in your share sheet with everyone else you know, except it’s a laptop, it’s always there, and it never has other plans.

Type “e.” Send. It landed while you were reading this.

e→In the
basket.No device picker.
No spinning.
No walking over to check.
03 / THE DESTINATION↗

One basket.

Everything in one feed on your Mac. Newest first. In the order it happened.

No folders. No inbox to keep at zero. No system for you to design, abandon, and feel bad about in four months.

Some of it you’ll deal with the moment you sit down. Some will sit there for three weeks.

Both are correct. That’s what a basket is for.

Nothing
to sort.
Nothing
to keep up
with.JUST KEEP IT.
04 / THE ONE YOU WERE LOOKING FOR↗

It knows
which egg.

You won’t remember what you called it. You didn’t call it anything. You were on a train.

Egg doesn’t need the word. It looks at what’s actually in the picture. Search “wheel” and the screenshot with a wheel in it comes back, having never once been labelled, tagged, filed, or thought about again by anyone.

Three thousand bookmarks and you can’t find the one. This is that, fixed.

You have 3,000 bookmarks.

You have found 0 of them.

THERE IS A BETTER WAY.
05 / ALSO

Menu bar only.

No Dock icon. Egg is there without moving in.

A note from the person making this

Still cooking.

A handful of us use Egg every day. It isn’t open yet; I’m letting people in slowly so I can keep up with what they tell me. Where things actually are:

Search is its own app right now. It works, and it’s the best thing about Egg. Folding it into the feed is the next big job.

The desktop side is being built. The feed is chronological and searchable today. That covers most of it. It isn’t finished.

Apple only. macOS 14 or later, and an iPhone.
